summary: Inuvo, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, reporting a securities purchase agreement with an accredited investor for a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement. The company issued 1,631,121 common shares at $1.00 per share, prefunded warrants at $0.999 per share, and Class A and B common stock purchase warrants with an exercise price of $1.28 per share. Terms include expiration dates of five years (Class A) and one year (Class B) from issuance. The offering was made under an effective shelf registration statement. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The transaction strengthens the company's capital position but dilutes existing shareholders. Watch for stock price and warrant exercise. Risk-arb: near-term dilution from warrant overhang.
